step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Hazards, First Aid & Safety): Generally, a wide-angle lens will give a larger angle ofview, while a telephoto lens compresses the subject and gives a smaller angle of view (p. 33).
Step 2 (Hazards, First Aid & Safety): A wide-angle lens is a good choicewhen you are close to your subject (p. 33).
Step 3 (Hazards, First Aid & Safety): A telephoto lens is best for subjects when you can't get up close (p. 33).
Step 4 (Hazards, First Aid & Safety): Earlier we discussed the importance of f-stops in controllingyour depth of field and what is in focus (p. 33).
